background: Coventry Building Society is the second-largest UK building society after Nationwide, a mutual funded by retail savings and lending almost entirely on residential and buy-to-let mortgages, and the owner of The Co-operative Bank.
synthesis: Fitch rates the society A+ after its upgrade on 12 May 2026 and Moody's A3, both stable. Capital is strong on the headline measure, with CET1 of 19.6% in the top quarter of UK building societies against a 17.8% median, but leverage of 4.7% is in the bottom quarter against 6.1%, which is the one figure to keep an eye on. Liquidity is comfortable, with LCR of 233% and NSFR of 147% both above their medians. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 1.7 points, leverage 0.6 points and LCR 21 points, which reflects the Co-operative Bank purchase. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
